scene.speaker: astrid
scene.bubble: Dress-up day at school! I am wearing my green dress and Tomás is wearing… a pirate hat?
scene.intro: Dress-up day at school! Astrid is wearing her green dress, her white socks and her favourite hat. Tomás is wearing a red t-shirt, blue trousers and one shoe — the other shoe is lost! They look for it in the classroom, in the garden and under the table. What are YOU wearing today? A jacket? Shorts? Say it in English and join the dress-up day!
